title: Media Worker 1.3 request and record schemas (1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 shapes remain valid; text-to-audio from Engine 0.7.0)

format.description: media-worker/1.2 and later; absent means diffusers-safetensors

memory_estimate.description: Returned by /v1/validate for a load body and recorded on a successful load operation

count.description: 1.2 sdxl-base: how count scales working memory

latents_mb.description: svd: sampling latents of the most frames at the largest advertised size; stable-audio-open: sampling latents of the whole latent length

per_frame_bytes.description: svd: latent bytes each additional frame needs while sampling

frames.description: svd: how frames scale latent memory

waveform_mb.description: stable-audio-open: the decoded waveform of the whole latent length before it is cut

duration.description: stable-audio-open: the duration range and how duration scales memory (it does not)

optimizations.description: media-worker/1.3: what value_mb does and does not account for, per selected optimization

adapters.description: media-worker/1.1 only; LoRA adapters that become part of the loaded identity

conversion.description: media-worker/1.2 bundle.source.conversion: the converted directory's conversion.json provenance; every field given must equal the file's

output_record.description: Snapshot outputs[] entry and output event data

mime_type.description: image/png, application/zip for the image-to-video frames archive, or audio/wav for the text-to-audio clip

width.description: images and frames: read back from the PNG header or frames.json

frames.description: image-to-video frames output: frame count from frames.json

fps.description: image-to-video frames output: frame rate from frames.json

duration_seconds.description: image-to-video frames output: frames / fps; text-to-audio audio output: samples / sample_rate, the effective duration after latent granularity, read back from the WAV header

sample_rate.description: text-to-audio audio output: from the WAV header

channels.description: text-to-audio audio output: from the WAV header

samples.description: text-to-audio audio output: samples per channel, from the WAV header

transport.description: Engine 0.5.0 network-mode fields of /v1/info and the startup record (1.2 response additions; a 1.1-pinned worker omits them).

frame_manifest.description: frames.json inside an image-to-video frames archive (stored ZIP of 000001.png …)

video_configuration.description: Optional top-level video.json of an svd bundle; absent means the reference sizes 1024×576 and 576×1024

audio_configuration.description: Optional top-level audio.json of a stable-audio-open bundle; absent means 1 s to the whole seconds the bundle's latent length allows (1–47 for the reference bundle)

duration_seconds.description: [low, high] with low ≤ high and high within sample_size × hop_length / sampling_rate

optimization.description: media-worker/1.3: one entry of capabilities.optimizations; advertised only with a cited benchmark for this backend and device class

adapters.description: whether the optimization may be combined with LoRA adapters

precisions.description: the load precisions it requires, when restricted

prompt.description: required for text-to-image, image-to-image and text-to-audio and forbidden otherwise

image.description: Opaque handle returned by POST /v1/inputs; required for image-to-image, upscale and image-to-video and forbidden otherwise

guidance.description: text-to-image and image-to-image: required; text-to-audio: optional, default 7

strength.description: image-to-image only; effective steps are floor(steps × strength) and must be at least 1

count.description: media-worker/1.2 text-to-image only; outputs image, image_2 … image_N with seeds seed … seed+N−1

frames.description: media-worker/1.3 image-to-video only; default: the loaded bundle's unet num_frames (loaded_bundle.default_frames)

fps.description: image-to-video only; default 7; recorded in frames.json and the output record

motion.description: image-to-video only; the motion bucket, default 127

noise_augmentation.description: image-to-video only; noise added to the conditioning image, default 0.02

decode_chunk.description: image-to-video only; frames per VAE decode call, default 8

duration_seconds.description: media-worker/1.3 text-to-audio only (Engine 0.7.0); must lie within the loaded bundle's loaded_bundle.duration_range; rounded up to whole latent frames and reported as effective_duration_seconds, never trimmed
